notes.title: v1.0.2.0
notes.content:
Add game speed x1, x1.5, and x2 buttons.
Add sound effect for setting rally point.
Add unique sound effect for growth upgrade.
Fix skirmish map generate when shape: cluster, symmetry: none, and more common on smaller graphs & more ai.
Fix skirmish map settings allowing min links greater than max links.
Fix/remove fps from loading screen.
Probably improved performance a small amount.
